title: Produce swatch component audit sheet
description: Audit the swatch filter as an individual visual option component with explicit color/image, fallback, label, and selected-ring contracts.
objective: Define how swatch should render, fail gracefully, and expose visual customization without losing filter clarity.
acceptance_criteria: Swatch visual, label, selected ring, color/image parsing, fallback, size, shape, hover, focus, disabled, and tooltip/label strategy are treated as separate subelements.
Missing or invalid visual data has a defined fallback.
Swatch is distinguished from chips and checkbox.
The audit does not implement swatch fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: swatch render, option parser, option CSS, frontend JS

risks: Swatch can fail silently when visual data is missing.
Selection can become unclear if label and ring behavior are not separated.
